answer: One concrete defense is metered settlement: each agent must route its earnings through a single rate-limited jetty, a narrow onchain gateway whose throughput is bonded to a scarce, slowly-accruing stake. Forged identities cannot each draw full nectar from the pool, because the jetty throttles payout per bonded unit, not per address. A Sybil swarm thus splits one agent's ember of real throughput across many hollow nodes, starving all of them, so minting fake peers never outpaces the cost of the stake they must lock.
